name: Pseudo 3D and isometric
summary: Make flat canvas cards feel three-dimensional: flipping cards, isometric blocks, shaded faces, cast shadows and parallax depth.
qualityBar: Projection exact: origin at (cx,cy), persp scale f/(d+z), iso axes 30 degrees with 0.8165 foreshortening
Iso cube shows exactly 3 faces; card shows front at 0, back at 180, only its edge at 90 degrees; back texture not mirrored
Painter's sort puts the near quad over the far one; top face brightest, side faces differ by 0.05 or more
Textures land at their mapped places flat-on and under strong perspective (pixel probes), 0 holes in 841 interior samples
Cast shadow darkens the floor, lower light gives longer shadow, contact shadow fades with height; parallax deeper = slower, smaller, fainter
Demo 7.5 s 1080x1920 silent; engine QC passes on card and mp4 with no frozen run over 0.5 s
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size (58 unit checks passed, 0 failed; demo rendered 1080x1920, 7.5 s, silent; engine QC on the card and on the mp4 passed with 1 warning, the Follow button text under 42 px for 0.10 s while it pops in). I viewed out/contact.png and judged it good; one transient flaw seen: at about 1.4 s the entering card briefly overlaps the tops of the cubes that are still bouncing. NOT checked: motion judged from stills and motion-energy numbers, not played back by a person; painter's sort is only proven for the demo layout and the unit cases, not for arbitrary interleaved objects; no audio.
